title: Finite integral scalar extension preserves the standard heart
statement: Let ℓ be prime, let E and L be finite extensions of Q_ℓ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and let i : E → L be a Q_ℓ-algebra embedding. Let X be a noetherian finite-dimensional scheme on which ℓ is invertible. Use the actual completed constructible integral categories [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete], their induced standard t-structures [prop-weil-pbc-integral-tstructure], and the integral scalar functor C_i of [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension]. If K is in the standard integral E-heart, then C_i(K) is in the standard integral L-heart. This assertion concerns integral objects before rationalization and includes arbitrary integral torsion in K.

source.place: Lemma 6.8.2(1), Proposition 6.8.11(3) and Proposition 6.8.14; integral finite-free scalar calculation in step 1 of lem-per-adic-common-stage-truncations

proof.text: The valuation-ring extension is finite free. Its integral basis and the cofinal uniformizer filtrations identify the completed target coefficient sheaf, with its residue-normalized scalar map, as finite free over the completed source. This is the coordinate argument of [lem-weil-completed-integral-finite-free], transported from constant quotient presentations to the actual continuous-function quotient sheaves by their canonical finite coefficient comparisons.

source.place: Lemma 6.8.2(1), Proposition 6.8.11(3) and Proposition 6.8.14; integral finite-free scalar calculation in step 1 of lem-per-adic-common-stage-truncations

proof.text: Restriction of ordinary scalar extension is a finite sum of copies of the input module, so it preserves kernels and cokernels. The universal K-flat derived change of rings of [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], computed on resolutions from [lem-pc-kflat-resolution], agrees with termwise derivation of this exact ordinary functor. Thus its nonzero-degree cohomology vanishes on an integral heart input. The actual scalar functor preserves constructible complete membership by [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension]. The induced integral heart of [prop-weil-pbc-integral-tstructure] is exactly ambient cohomology concentrated in degree zero, proving the conclusion.
